text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kris S! Mind coming shopping with me 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I don't mind, but... —What... do you 
intend to buy?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Earrings! The 'voice of destiny' told me 
so— that if I go with you, I'll find the 
best earrings today!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, your ears look very 
much alike. They're so big, fluffy, and 
incredibly cute♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right~? But it's a bit tricky to wear. 
It's so fluffy that my ear ornament slips 
right off!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's why I asked Kris S, who knows all 
kinds of stuff, for some recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's a struggle born from 
individuality, isn't it? Still, having 
matching ones makes me a bit envious♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—Don't worry— —Epi—shares many 
similarities... with you as well."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. Once her switch is flipped... she 
charges straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, totally! Once Cesario flips her 
switch, she's like, totally strict and 
whipping into shape~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that... so, maybe? Fufu, so they 
look alike...
